[SWS_DM_01396] SOVD method Start Execution of an Operation
⌈
For each SOVD operation configured the Diagnostic Server Instance shall provide the
SOVD method Start Execution of an Operation according to ASAM SOVD[2].
The Diagnostic Server Instance shall execute the method analog to Service Rou-
tineControl (0x31) with SubFunction Start (0x01) of ISO 14229-1[1].
⌋

⌈
For each DiagnosticSovdOperationStart, the Diagnostic Server in-
stance shall provide the SOVD method Start Execution of an Operation ac-
cording to ASAM SOVD[5][14].
⌋
